projects.name: 1. Sales Performance Dashboard using Snowflake & Tableau
projects.description:
1. Sales Performance Dashboard using Snowflake & Tableau
Designed optimized data models and automated ETL pipelines using Python.
Integrated data from Convertr and Salesforce by automating report downloads using Python Playwright.
Reduced manual reporting time by 60% and improved data-driven decision-making.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) for data security.
Designed a Tableau dashboard for real-time insights from Snowflake & S3-stored data.
2. Automated Data Pipeline for Convertr, Salesforce & AWS S3
Automated XLSX report downloads from Convertr & Salesforce using Python Playwright, reducing manual effort.
Processed data using Snowflake Stages & AWS S3 (Athena) for efficient storage & retrieval.
Implemented data cleansing queries before appending data to Snowflake tables.
Built a Tableau dashboard for real-time visualization of cleaned data from both Snowflake and S3.

languages: English, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Hindi, Marathi, Malayalam
